name: Stalker Voices
teaser: Adds NPC voices from the game series "S.T.A.L.K.E.R."  Includes only 6 so far, with more coming in the future.
description_html:
THIS (AND MY OTHER MODS) WILL NOT GET UPDATED ANYMORE ON ACCOUNT ME (JustNU) LEAVING THE SPT-AKI COMMUNITY

ALL OF MY MODS ARE UNLICENCE AKA PUBLIC DOMAIN, SO ANYONE WHO WISHES TO UPDATE/IMPROVE/TAKE OVER THE DEVELOPMENT IS FREE TO DO SO

I HAVE ALSO UPDATED SOURCE ENTRY FOR EVERY MOD OF MINE, IN CASE YOU WANT THE GITHUB REPOS

LINK TO GITHUB REPO OF THIS MOD’S SERVER SIDE

LINK TO GDRIVE ARCHIVE WITH THE LATEST VERSION UNITY PROJECT REQUIRED TO MAKE VOICE BUNDLES

Adds following voices that can be used by player and bots alike:
- Bandit 1 (Finished).
- Freedom (Unfinished).
- Loner 2 (Unfinished).
- Monolith 2 (from CoP, gasmask filter, unfinished).
- Duty (Unfinished).
- Clear Sky (Unfinished).

Has a config file that allows to add (or fully replace) voices to bots, by default:
- Bandit voice goes to Scavs.
- Freedom voice goes to Shturman (Full replace).
- Loner voice goes to Shturman guards (Full replace).
- Duty voice goes to Bears.
- Clear Sky voice goes to Glukhar guards (Full replace).

Demo of the voices:
- Bandit.
- Freedom.
- Loner 2.
- Monolith 2.

Known issues:
- Some voices are unfinished and as such miss some phrases.
- Most likely messed up some phrases.
- Not a lot of phrases overall, but should be enough for fights and mumbles.
- Some voice lines have sudden cut-offs (skill issue on my side).
- Some lines are repeated for multiple phrases.

Planned:
- Complete release of all voices - 1.0.0
- Tutorial and a unity template (will come after 1.0.0).

Credits:
- CWX for the BepInEx plugin work.
- SamSWAT for several improvements and overall help with unity.
- Kmyuhkyuk for inspiring me by making GFL voices mod.
- GSC Game World for making S.T.A.L.K.E.R.
